content.title: Jasprit Bumrah Mixes Up Run-Up in Bid to End Wicketless Spell
content.caption: Jasprit Bumrah's unusual run-up during the second Test against New Zealand showcases his determination to end his wicketless streak.

slides.heading: Jasprit Bumrah Mixes Up Run-Up in Bid to End Wicketless
slides.text: Jasprit Bumrah's unusual run-up during the second Test against New Zealand showcases his determination to end his wicketless streak.

slides.heading: Run-Up Unusual
slides.text: During the second session, Bumrah took longer strides and stretched his arms ahead of his body while running in instead of hiding the ball with both hands.

slides.heading: Impact on Game
slides.text: The unusual run-up may have added to the element of surprise and helped India end New Zealand's wicketless streak.
